headline: Committee passes Bill 32 on first reading, defers grant overview and budget procedures

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.summary: Bill 32 passed first reading, eight ayes with one excused. The committee deferred the federal disaster recovery grant overview and budget procedures. The Mayor's budget is due March 25, and committee budget deliberations begin March 31.
meeting.recap: The committee had three items: an overview of federal disaster recovery grants, Bill 32, and its budget review procedures.[[0:03:36]] He said HUD, the federal housing agency, has recommended approval of $81,969,000 to run the program.[[0:23:00]] Staff said ten of the 56 grant-funded positions have been hired.[[0:44:41]] He said $903 million is set aside for housing, starting in Lahaina.[[1:06:15]] Bill 32 passed first reading with eight ayes and one member excused.[[1:47:21]] The Mayor's budget is due to the Council on March 25 at 10 o'clock.[[1:49:03]] Committee budget deliberations begin March 31 at 9 a.m.[[1:51:59]] The chair said district meetings will not be held online this year, but Akaka will film them.[[2:17:00]] The committee deferred the budget procedures item and adjourned.[[2:27:12]]
decided: The committee deferred the overview item on federal disaster recovery grant funding.
meeting.next: HUD will tell the County yes or no on the action plan within 45 days. The County's request for proposals for an implementation contractor closes in about two weeks. Program policies and eligibility intake will be developed after the action plan, aiming for this summer. The chair said the administration will give the Council reports on the grant.

moments.q: "DR is that funding of last resort"
A member: "it's a big leap of trust on our part."
District meetings will be filmed by Akaka

issues.oneLine: The County may use disaster recovery money as a last option for a West Maui project with four wells.
issues.why: The administrator said the wells would bring more water to West Maui for fighting fires and building housing.
issues.next: The County is applying for state revolving fund money for the well project.
issues.brief: The County applied for hazard mitigation funds for the well project but did not get them.[[#1]] The administrator said the well project would support about 3,200 housing units.[[#2]] The Department of Water Supply is applying for the wells now.[[#3]]

issues.oneLine: The draft action plan sets aside $903 million for housing, starting in Lahaina.
issues.why: The administrator said data and community feedback show housing is the biggest need.
issues.brief: Planned programs include single-family home rebuilding and multi-family rental rebuilding.[[#1]] Staff said they are looking at deed restriction programs tied to the funding to help keep properties with families.[[#2]] Staff said housing projects not funded by the Affordable Housing Fund can apply for this grant.[[#3]]
